Wrote `spec.md` + `acceptance.md` (replaced stale kanban-archive spec from prior task).

**Spec core:**
- Target = app logo `⎇ Bridza` in sidebar header (`src/app/features/nav.jsx:45`, `.brand` in `bridza.css:52`) — not landing page logo.
- "First time" = new LS marker key in `LS` map (`src/app/lib/format.js:10`), written at first mount → never replays.
- Pure CSS keyframe, `transform: scale()` only, double-beat × 3 cycles, `prefers-reduced-motion` guard. No dep, no JS loop.

**Decisions I made** (intent left open, flagging):
- Once *ever*, not once per session/day — "first time" read literally. Contrast: welcome dialog uses per-day (`App.jsx:25`).
- Finite cycles, not looping forever.
- Marker still written for reduced-motion users → no surprise pulse later.

**Out of scope, stated:** landing logo, replay setting, other trigger points, artwork change.
